newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 19.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:
* Barbra Streisand's Barwood Films is in "very serious discussions" with King World Productions for a development and production agreement.
* Cineplex Odeon and Sony Theatres are in merger talks, stirring a mixture of concern and skepticism about the prospect of such a deal.
* Former CBS comedy vice president David Himelfarb has been named senior vice president of network TV at Walt Disney TV.
* Joe Dante has agreed to direct the fantasy adventure "Small Soldiers" for DreamWorks.
* British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc lost 770 million pounds ($1.3 billion) in value on Wednesday on news that it would be shut out of bidding for new digital TV licenses.
* Ken Berry, who became president of EMI Group Plc's recorded music division in late May, has decided to close EMI Records and the Enclave record label.
